import time
	row_selection=self.parent.parent.getChild("Table").props.selection.data

	messageboxparams={"data":{"icon": "material/info",

		  }
		  }
	
	
	if len(row_selection)!=0:
		
		equipment_group_id=self.parent.parent.getChild("Table").props.selection.data[0].equipment_group_id

		params={"equipment_group_id":equipment_group_id,
				 "database":database}
		check_equipment_group_assignment_relationship_call=system.db.execQuery("API/Equipment_Manager/Equipment_Group/Check_If_Equipment_Group_In_Assignment", params)
			
		##check if equipment_group belongs to an assignment
		if len(check_equipment_group_assignment_relationship_call)==1:
			related_assignment=check_equipment_group_assignment_relationship_call[0]['assignment_name']
				
			messageboxparams['data']['message']="""The Equipment Group {0} belongs to the Assignment: {1}. You must first delete the Assignment, then delete the Equipment Group.""".format(equipment_group_name, related_assignment)
			messageboxparams['data']['title']="Equipment Group Belongs to Assignment"
				  
			system.perspective.openPopup("AlertMessage", "API_Screens/Pop_Ups/Message_Box",messageboxparams, showCloseIcon=False, draggable=False, resizable=False, modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)

		else:
			payload={"title":"Delete Equipment Group",
				"message":"""Are you sure you want to delete equipment group  {0} ?""".format(equipment_group_name),
				"named_query_path":["API/Equipment_Manager/Equipment/Disable"],			
				"ids":{"equipment_group_id":equipment_group_id},
				"param_names":["equipment_group_id"],
				"data":row_selection}

		
			system.perspective.openPopup("DeleteConfirmation", "API_Screens/Pop_Ups/Delete_Confimation_Equipment_Group", showCloseIcon=False, draggable=False, resizable=False, modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
			time.sleep(.1)
			system.perspective.sendMessage("delete_equipment_group_data", payload)

##Selected Rows
	selected_rows=self.parent.parent.getChild("Table").props.selection.data
	
	headers=["equipment_name", "description", "equipment_group_name"]
	# Then create an empty list, this will house our data.
	data = []
	
	first_pass=True
	for row in selected_rows:
			
		params={"equipment_group_id":row['equipment_group_id']}
		call=system.db.execQuery("API/Equipment_Manager/Equipment_Group/Export", params)
	
		
		for row in call:
			data.append(row)
			
		
	joined_dataset=system.dataset.toDataset(headers, data)
		
	csvString=system.dataset.toCSV(joined_dataset, showHeaders=True, forExport=True)
	
	system.perspective.download("equipmentGroup.csv", csvString, "text/csv")
